QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Gesture of Good Will
QuestInfo.0: Upon hearing mention of the Knights, Claudine has started giving you the cold shoulder. But you can't back out now. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine is going to test you. Go infiltrate the Black Wings' hideout, find their laboratory, and rescue a child held captive within.
QuestInfo.2: You saved several children from the Black Wings' prison. In exchange, Claudine promised to consider Ereve's proposal. But she looks a bit troubled for some reason...

default.0: You're not having second thoughts, are you? Enter the secret passage by the #bMine Entrance#k. That's all I'm going to say.\r\n
